Purpose
This policy sets out the rules on sick leave notification at Vandenberg Logistics NV.
Policy
Employees notify their manager on the first day of absence. A medical certificate is required from
the 3rd consecutive day of absence.
Validity
Version 1.2, effective 2021-07-01. Next review: 2023-10-31.
